summary: Phase S1 is accepted at HEAD 035f54eb3b87c0ab874d2e89c39a5b8a3e0b73a5. All four S1 lib modules (lib/grammar.mjs, lib/manifest.mjs, lib/preflight.mjs, lib/agents-snapshot.mjs) and the targeted MODEL_MAP/config-model-map.json entry for xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 are implemented and fully verified. Live cross-directory hard-link parity verified: 29 agents in source and both full-mirror targets; 13 measure-only entries in Desktop/measure/agents; inode equality confirmed. Story S1 acceptance criteria (AC1 manifest schema, AC2 preflight blocks, AC3 grammar canonical, AC4 grammar versioning) all verified. Plan tasks S1.1–S1.8 all pass. ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.signature_consistency: All four lib modules follow lib/core.mjs conventions: destructured options objects for complex inputs ({sourceDir, fullMirrorDirs, measureOnlyDir}), structured return values ({ok, reason?, warnings?}), sorted output for stable iteration (agents-snapshot sorts file names, computeStabilityHashes sorts input paths, manifest agentNames are sorted).
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.error_structured: Every failure emits a regex-parseable string: drift:agent:<file>, drift:extension, schema_version_mismatch, missing_reference:<name>, unmapped_model:<name>, marker_grammar:legacy_in_active_run, no_completed_tasks, empty_source:<path>, missing_file:<path>, extra_file:<path>, content_mismatch:<path>, not_hard_link:<path>:<dev>:<ino>, symlink_detected:<path>. classifyLinkError maps EXDEV→cross_filesystem, EPERM→permission_denied, EROFS→readonly_filesystem.
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.env_overridable: tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs reads OPENCODE_AGENT_DIR, OPENCODE_AGENTS_TARGET_DIRS, OPENCODE_MEASURE_ONLY_DIR env vars for live-behavior probes, mirroring scripts/parity.mjs. lib constants DEFAULT_SOURCE_DIR, DEFAULT_FULL_MIRROR_DIRS (frozen), DEFAULT_MEASURE_ONLY_DIR are homedir-anchored.
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.deterministic: All four lib modules are pure functions over their inputs. No Date.now(), Math.random(), or process.hrtime() in any of lib/grammar.mjs, lib/manifest.mjs, lib/preflight.mjs, lib/agents-snapshot.mjs. formatPreflightError and formatSnapshotError are template-literal-only with no time/random tokens. tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs test #13 (deterministic) explicitly asserts verifyHardLinkSnapshot output does not embed Date.now().toString().
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.contract_match: Every documented symbol is exported: CANONICAL_REGEX, isTaskStructurallyBlocked, classifyMarker, parseTaskLine (lib/grammar.mjs); loadManifest, validateManifest, computeStabilityHashes (lib/manifest.mjs); runPreflight, formatPreflightError (lib/preflight.mjs); EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT, EXPECTED_MEASURE_AGENT_COUNT, MEASURE_ONLY_PATTERN, DEFAULT_SOURCE_DIR, DEFAULT_FULL_MIRROR_DIRS, DEFAULT_MEASURE_ONLY_DIR, verifyHardLinkSnapshot, verifyHardLinkRelationship, compareHardLinkInventory, classifyLinkError, formatSnapshotError (lib/agents-snapshot.mjs).
